trailhead.label: The Chiesetta del Mucciòn above Monte Magrè, the published start

cautions: The ridge has meadows and pastures: keep your dog close where animals graze.
Cars park on the lane by the church and the trattoria: keep your dog on a short lead at the start.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.The Chiesetta del Mucciòn above Monte Ma: La chiesetta del Mucciòn sopra Monte Magrè, la partenza ufficiale
textIt.The ridge has meadows and pastures: keep: Sul crinale ci sono prati e pascoli: tieni il cane vicino dove pascolano gli animali.
textIt.Cars park on the lane by the church and: Le auto parcheggiano sulla stradina accanto alla chiesetta e alla trattoria: alla partenza tieni il cane al guinzaglio corto.
